written_by: mandate-maps worker, regional data round, 9 October 2026
written_before: any view of sheet 19-14 tiles, the 1940s vector overlay over Jericho, or modern imagery of the zone

registered_prediction.copied_from: research/assessments/kohlit_chain/chain.json, model M-SULTAN, next link SULTAN-1-precamp-mouth (unchanged since commit 2ae0976)
registered_prediction.expect: A non-funerary opening (shaft, cistern or pit mouth, 1 m or wider) with at least one grave cut or tomb opening within 10 m of it.
registered_prediction.where: The strip from the tell's north foot to about 250 m north: Kenyon II p. 169 skipped it; Area D lies about 100–200 m north (Fig. 91, inference). Under the ʿAin es-Sultan camp since 1948.
registered_prediction.success: The opening and the grave appear in one registered record, and their distance is 'inside' 10 m under registration_protocol.md.
registered_prediction.contradiction: Photographs and plans alone cannot contradict: absence may be concealment, burial or resolution. A contradiction needs a coverage-gated excavation record of the strip (coverage module gates) that reached the ancient surface and reports no such pair.
registered_prediction.notes: Locating an opening does not date it. A success opens the next link (R-E60-PIT-PERIOD, R-E60-JOINT-ACCESS) on the same feature.

record_specific_expectation: This record is a 1:20,000 map. Its drawing accuracy (about 0.2–0.5 mm, 4–10 m) and its symbol sizes make E_total <= 2.5 m (mouth_10m) very unlikely. Expected outcome for SULTAN-1: not testable by this record, whatever the map prints. The north_sector threshold (10 m) may or may not be met. A symbol in the zone would locate only a mapped item of the 1940s; it would not date it and would not satisfy SULTAN-1 unless the mouth_10m relation is accepted.

document.title: Survey of Palestine 1:20,000, sheet 19-14 Jericho, as served by Palestine Open Maps (tile layer pal20k-1940s, zoom 16)
document.custodian: Palestine Open Maps (Visualizing Palestine); scan source credited to the National Library of Israel
document.date: 1940s; the served edition (undated file or 1942 file) is not determined in advance
document.kind: map (georeferenced web tiles of a printed topo-cadastral sheet)
document.extent_grid: EPSG:28191 E 189500–194500, N 140000–145000 (tiles intersecting this box, zoom 16)
document.sha256: SHA-256 of the sorted tile manifest (one line per tile: z/x/y and its SHA-256), computed at download and recorded in the section-8 record before any preview

source_axes: pixel_y_down (pixels of the full-resolution zoom-16 mosaic of the extent above)

target_frame.crs: EPSG:28191 Palestine Grid metres (= WBADB Old Israel Grid minus 1,000,000 m N)
target_frame.conversion: pyproj EPSG:4326 -> EPSG:28191, PROJ default operation (name recorded in the record)
target_frame.reference_source: Esri World Imagery, zoom 18–19, coordinates picked on masked mosaics

control_candidates: RP-TAWAHIN (only if the map labels the sugar mills: the identity check)
RP-ABU-HINDI (only if the map labels it)
RP-ROADS (only a junction on an alignment unchanged between the map and 2025; never the check)
control_rule: Use every listed candidate that the map shows with a definable point outside the mask, at the point defined in reference_points.json. At least three. The choice is made on the masked mosaics before any fit.
check_point_rule: RP-SPRING if the coarse preview shows the spring outside the mask; otherwise the eligible candidate nearest to the zone that the map shows. Decided on the coarse preview and written into the section-8 record before fitting.

zone_and_mask.mask_placement: Placed in the tile frame by the mean G1 tile offset measured on sheets 19-13 and 18-14, plus 50 m on every side (plan.json). The numbers used are written into the section-8 record before the preview.
zone_and_mask.stricter_than_protocol: The protocol asks for a preview at 5 m per pixel or coarser with the zone marked. A map draws symbols larger than the features, so the zone is painted solid on every view until the fit is saved.

secondary_exploratory_fit: A similarity fit to printed grid intersections outside the mask, with the same withheld check point, computed with registration.fit_similarity directly. Labelled exploratory: grid points are not in reference_points.json.
no_rescue: Controls, transform and check point are fixed before the fit. A later change is a new exploratory registration and is logged as such.
